name: Breast Pathology: Benign Lesions and Carcinoma

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Indian file cells with lost E cadherin mean invasive lobular carcinoma
Non healing nipple eczema means Paget disease until biopsied otherwise
Triple negative means no ER, PR or HER2 targets
Inflammatory carcinoma is a clinical dermal lymphatic diagnosis staged advanced
reference.pathophysiology: Stepwise accumulation of driver mutations in ductal or lobular epithelium progresses through hyperplasia and in situ disease to invasion when myoepithelial and basement barriers breach. Hormone receptor and HER2 signalling subtypes diverge in growth, spread pattern and drug sensitivity, while desmoplasia creates the hard palpable mass.
additionalInvestigations: Triple assessment: examination, imaging and core biopsy
ER, PR and HER2 immunohistochemistry on every cancer
Sentinel node biopsy for axillary staging
